eval-bot: nightly-eval ALERT — model=llama3-13b fp8-postcalib run=2026-03-17T07:00Z. Metric=QA_F1 on squad-like promptset dropped 89.4 -> 78.1 (delta -11.3). Log: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/1760357890
cheng: tagging eng-ml. @anya @mike @eva can someone triage? This is post-calibration FP8 profile — could be calibration set drift or a clipping/overflows issue. :eyes:
anya: on it, grabbing quant-dump and calib stats now.
anya: quick snapshot from the nightly sample generations — look at answer for qid=4532:
```
Q: What does the function `compute_score()` return on empty input?
Gold: "0"
FP32: "0"
FP8-postcalib: "It returns a dictionary with 'score' set to null."
```
anya: that's a clear format hallucination for a deterministic QA case. saving examples to /nfs/evals/1760357890/samples.jsonl
mike: I repro locally with the nightly config. Ran `./run_eval --model=llama3-13b --quant=fp8-postcalib --seed=42 --suite=squadlike` -> EM=75.8 F1=77.0, consistent with the drop.
mike: quick logs show saturations in some attention scales during forward pass:
```
WARN: layer=23 attn.q scale INF -> clipped
WARN: postcalib scaling factor 1.84 exceeds threshold 1.5
```
eva: could be calibration dataset mismatch. Last change to calib pipeline added ~50k code examples to the mix (PR #482). Code tokens have different activation statistics.
eva: suggested immediate steps: 1) rerun calibration with original calib shard (wiki+news) 2) run fp8 quant without postcalib step as control 3) inspect per-layer scale histograms.
cheng: plan sounds good. @anya can you dump the per-layer scale hist in CSV and share? @mike please run the two control evals. I'll prepare a rollback plan if FP8 remains bad.
anya: dumping now. snippet:
```
layer,mean_scale,std_scale,max_scale
0,0.012,0.003,0.045
10,0.089,0.021,0.34
23,0.41,0.12,1.92  <- outlier
49,0.05,0.011,0.18
```
anya: layer 23 max_scale 1.92 looks suspiciously high compared to others.
mike: re-runs results:
- fp8-no-postcalib -> F1=88.6 EM=86.9
- fp8-postcalib (repro) -> F1=77.2 EM=75.8
- fp32 baseline -> F1=89.5 EM=87.8
mike: seems postcalib step is the main delta. Possibly a clipping threshold or per-channel outlier handling bug.
eva: maybe the post-calib optimizer uses a different percentile (99.9 -> 99.99) due to that recent PR. That'd amplify scales from code tokens.
cheng: good catch. @anya can you re-run calibration with the original percentile (99.9) and also with a clipped-percentile 99.5 to see sensitivity? Also tag infra: we might need to pin quant kernels if results change across hosts.
anya: running two calib jobs now: `python tools/calib.py --model=llama3-13b --dataset=orig-calib --percentile=99.9` and `--percentile=99.5`. estimate ~12m each. will post results.
mike: also note we saw one NaN in scale computation in the nightly logs — probably from a zero-variance micro-batch. adding a guard to ignore zero-var channels. will push patch to eval harness.
eva: if re-calib fixes >5 points we can patch and re-benchmark. if not, we should roll back FP8 config in production routing and file an infra ticket for kernel/accel investigation.
cheng: ok action items: anya=run calib variants + dump histograms, mike=hardening patch + reproduce with fixed seed, eva=prepare rollback and infra ticket template, i'll coordinate with product on customer-facing impact. target update in 2h. :thumbsup:
anya: calib-99.9 result -> postcalib F1=86.5 EM=84.7 (much better). calib-99.5 -> F1=87.1 EM=85.2
anya: hist for 99.9 shows layer23 max_scale reduced to 1.02
```
layer,mean_scale,std_scale,max_scale
23,0.21,0.07,1.02
```
mike: nice. my local patch also prevents NaN and reduces variance of scales. after patch + calib99.9 I get F1=88.4 EM=86.6 which is within noise of FP32 baseline.
eva: I'll hold rollback unless we see regression in next 24h; opening infra ticket to pin quant-kernel build used by nightly so we can replicate exactly. ticket: #DEVOPS-1219
cheng: great triage. marking this thread resolved for now — follow-on: add a regression test that compares postcalib percentile changes and flags >3pt drop.
eval-bot: re-run summary (2026-03-17T08:45Z): fp8-postcalib with calib-percentile=99.9 -> F1 88.4 (mitigated). Closing alert.
